title: Look up a basket's prices, gaps included, and print its labels

blocks.text: A grocery app prices a basket against the store's price table and hands the list of prices to the checkout, the receipt and the analytics services. A product with no price yet must show up as a gap (`null`) in its place, not break the basket. Last month the analytics service appended a discount to the list it was given, and the receipt printed it as an item; nobody may change the list again.

items: `pricesOf(...)`: one price per code, in order, `null` where the table has none;
`labelsFor(...)`: the codes that are not discontinued, as the `String[]` the shelf printer takes.

cases.says: a basket whose codes are all in the table gets their prices in basket order, repeats included
a code the table doesn't know gets null in its place, and the other prices are still returned
adding, replacing or removing an entry of the returned list throws UnsupportedOperationException
the labels are the codes that are not discontinued, in order, in a String[]

origin.section: toList(), Collectors.toList() and toUnmodifiableList() Return Three Different Lists

concepts: Stream.toList() is unmodifiable and keeps nulls, Collectors.toList() promises no mutability (an ArrayList in Java 21), and toUnmodifiableList() throws NullPointerException on a null.
toArray() returns Object[], and casting it to String[] throws ClassCastException; toArray(String[]::new) returns a String[].
